title_zh: 按邮件附件启用线上展览访问

scenario.label_zh: 解决线上展览访问问题
scenario.goal_zh: 找到邮件说明中的访问启用链接并确认展览可以打开

context_zh: 埃米尔联系虚构线上画廊的支持人员，询问全球开放的展览为何仍显示欢迎页面。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Visitor Emil
sentences.text: Your email announced a worldwide launch today, but I still cannot enter the exhibition.

sentences.speaker: Support Jules
sentences.text: Does the page show a welcome message or an error?

sentences.speaker: Visitor Emil
sentences.text: A welcome message. I clicked the main picture in the email.

sentences.speaker: Support Jules
sentences.text: The instructions are in the PDF attachment. Open that and use the link labelled Activate my visit.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Emil
sentences.text: Do I have to activate it every time?

sentences.speaker: Support Jules
sentences.text: No, just for this first visit. After that, save the gallery address.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Emil
sentences.text: I have opened the link, and now I can see the first room. That was the step I missed.

sentences.speaker: Support Jules
sentences.text: Great. You can move between rooms using the arrows at the bottom.

targets.sense_zh: 面向全球的，世界范围的
使开始运行或生效，启用
